title: Everpure Intelligent Control Plane: Connecting Storage Intelligence to Cyber Resilience
summary: Explore how Veeam, Rubrik, and Commvault integrate with the Everpure Intelligent Control Plane to help close storage blind spots and strengthen cyber resilience.
body_markdown:
### Summary


Veeam, Rubrik, and Commvault have each integrated with the Everpure Intelligent Control Plane to connect storage intelligence with cyber resilience workflows, helping customers detect anomalies, gain fleet-wide context, and accelerate recovery with the data protection tools they already use.


Vendors don’t integrate with someone else’s platform out of the goodness of their hearts. They do it because it adds capability to their own product and because that capability turns into better outcomes for their customers. They recognize that value enough to spend their own engineering time, support overhead, and roadmap attention capturing it—time they could have spent somewhere else.


Therefore, when three leading cyber resilience vendors make that same call independently, aimed at the same part of a platform, that’s a signal.


Everpure built the Intelligent Control Plane—powered by[Pure1](https://www.everpuredata.com/products/monitoring-fleet-management.html) ® and[Everpure Fusion](https://www.everpuredata.com/products/automation-orchestration.html) ™—as the centerpiece of our[Enterprise Data Cloud](https://www.everpuredata.com/enterprise-data-cloud.html) vision: treat data holistically and manage storage as one fleet instead of array by array. Veeam, Rubrik, and Commvault—the top data protection vendors in the industry—have each integrated their own products with the Everpure Intelligent Control Plane. Each integration was its own engineering decision, made independently by a different company, yet each one points to the same layer: the Everpure Intelligent Control Plane.


## **Closing the blind spot**


The Intelligent Control Plane gives customers visibility across their entire fleet, policy that’s defined once and enforced everywhere, and orchestration that replaces manual, array-by-array administration with something closer to how modern cloud platforms actually operate. That’s the case Everpure makes for our Enterprise Data Cloud vision.


*Figure 1: The Enterprise Data Cloud (EDC), powered by the Everpure Platform.*


It’s also a cyber resilience case. Storage that sits outside a fleet-wide control plane is a blind spot, and blind spots are exactly where ransomware and other attacks do the most damage. Detection that happens only after data has already been restored or investigated by hand across disconnected tools is detection that arrives too late to matter.


The Intelligent Control Plane closes that gap by making storage part of the detection and response loop itself, not just something that gets attacked and then eventually recovered. And three of the top data protection vendors are leveraging the Everpure Intelligent Control Plane to enhance their own products:


- **Veeam: Recovery that moves with the fleet:** Veeam’s Anomaly Awareness Workflow follows this model directly. Everpure Fusion registers every Everpure system inside Veeam Backup & Replication and enforces one protection policy across the fleet, instead of leaving admins to configure array by array. When Pure1 detects abnormal behavior on a volume, Everpure Fusion enriches that signal with array and workload context and hands it to Veeam—which automatically flags the affected restore points as suspicious, right inside the console admins already use.


- **Rubrik: Threats tagged the moment they’re found:** Rubrik’s threat-tagging integration works in the other direction. Rubrik scans backup data for indicators of compromise, and when it detects a threat, a workflow deployed through Pure1 uses Everpure Fusion to automatically tag the affected[FlashArray](https://www.everpuredata.com/products/block-file-object-storage.html) ™ volumes and snapshots using Rubrik’s threat intelligence.


- **Commvault: From signal to action, fast:** Commvault’s Anomaly Workflow follows the same approach inside Commvault’s own ecosystem. Pure1 detects a storage anomaly, Everpure Fusion enriches that signal with fleet and array context, and Commvault takes it from there—mapping the anomaly to the specific protected clients or VMs affected and raising an event inside its own Cloud Threat Scan. In simple terms: Pure1 detects, Everpure Fusion enriches, and Commvault operationalizes.


## **The common thread**


The power of the Everpure Platform is clear: Three independently built data protection platforms use the Everpure Intelligent Control Plane to connect storage intelligence and fleet context with protection and recovery workflows. The integrations work differently, but they demonstrate the same point.


Veeam and Commvault follow a similar pattern: Pure1 detects, Everpure Fusion enriches, and the partner operationalizes. Rubrik starts with threat intelligence from Rubrik Security Cloud, which the Pure1 and Everpure Fusion integration makes actionable on affected FlashArray volumes and snapshots. Together, they show that the Everpure Intelligent Control Plane extends into the data protection ecosystems customers already use.


## **Why this matters**


Taken together, these integrations point to something bigger. For users, the value is straightforward: Whichever of these tools you’ve already standardized on, the Everpure Platform meets you there.


No ripping anything out, no new console to learn, just storage intelligence, fleet-wide context, and automated workflows connected to the protection tools already in use—the kind of cyber resilience that comes from making storage part of the detection, investigation, and recovery process.


For everyone watching the broader Enterprise Data Cloud story, the takeaway is a little bigger: This is what independent validation looks like. Veeam, Rubrik, and Commvault didn’t need to connect to the Everpure Intelligent Control Plane—they did it because it gives their shared customers something concrete: a storage layer that flags trouble before it spreads, context that narrows an investigation instead of widening it, and a faster, more confident path to a clean recovery point. That’s the value Everpure built. Three competitors spending their own engineering resources to connect to it is proof of its power.


If Veeam, Rubrik, or Commvault solutions are already part of your environment, the fastest way to see this for yourself is to ask your Everpure or partner account team to walk through the integration built for the tools you already run. See how Pure1 and Everpure Fusion extend the Everpure Intelligent Control Plane into your existing data protection environment.
